title: Edmund and the Autopsy
author: Lena Almeida
blurb: Oscar Yarrow, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
